    • startCharge

      public void startCharge(com.badlogic.gdx.math.Vector2 direction)
      Begins charging a shot, e.g. while the player holds the shoot button down. No-ops if the bow is on cooldown. Does not start the cooldown itself - that happens once the shot actually fires, so a long charge doesn't eat into the post-shot cooldown window.
      Parameters:
      direction - Aim direction at the moment charging started (used only for facing/animation).

    • releaseCharge

      public void releaseCharge(com.badlogic.gdx.math.Vector2 direction)
      Fires the currently charging shot, if any, with speed scaled linearly by how long it was held (from MIN_CHARGE_SPEED_FACTOR at 0s up to full speed at MAX_CHARGE_SECONDS). No-ops if nothing was charging.
      Parameters:
      direction - Aim direction at release time.
